source: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. Published in the Gazette of India as Schedule-I of the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013 (as amended); released 13 September 2022.
extraction: Extracted directly from the gazette PDF with pdfplumber, reading the table ruling lines rather than the text layout. Every row carries the gazette page it came from. The Hindi copy of the schedule in the same document is excluded.
coverage: Sections 1-27, complete: 450 schedule entries, 378 distinct medicine names.
